tags.name: CIMD
tags.description: Endpoints for managing the tenant-wide permission ceiling of OAuth Client ID Metadata Document (CIMD) clients. CIMD clients are unregistered, so the ceiling applies to all of them; the enablement switch itself lives under `/api/configs/cimd`.

get.description: List the tenant-level permission ceiling for CIMD clients: user scopes, API resource scopes, organization scopes, and organization API resource scopes.

post.description: Add scopes to the tenant-level permission ceiling for CIMD clients. Database-backed scopes are referenced by ID; Management API scopes can never be selected.

422.description: Some scopes do not exist or are not allowed.

delete.summary: Delete a CIMD user consent scope
delete.description: Remove a scope from the tenant-level permission ceiling for CIMD clients.

404.description: The scope relation was not found.
